title: D-024 Amendment 8 unit L: one-way Telegram notification sink (owner-gated live send)
objective: Amendment 8 (R241-R245 + R231/R232/R246/R248/R249): bounded one-way Telegram sink over the existing NotificationSink boundary for exactly the eight listed conditions (STOP_FOR_OWNER, approval waiting, breaker/stuck, repeated CI failure, unrecovered controller/session failure, quota/refusal hold, golden-run completion, campaign completion); no Telegram approvals/merges/execution/config changes; bot token + chat id only in an approved local secret mechanism (never Git/packets/logs/telemetry/reports/messages); redaction, bounded retries, deduplication, failure isolation so Telegram downtime cannot stop the loop; the real send remains an owner-gated exact-command canary (R245). Supervisor-freeze qualifying evidence: D-024-R232/R241.
business_reason: Owner-required capability before continuous-mode activation (Amendment 8, R232).
outputs: telegram sink module under tools/agent_supervisor (one-way; secrets via approved local mechanism)
